summary: Client-only fix: the pi-envoy daemon client shares one /legion/v1/worker-session recovery per forgotten secret across every request refused while it runs (per session id: newest recovered secret + in-flight recovery; one retry per request), and roleDaemon() in extensions/legion.ts hands every caller one client per session. Two regression tests fail on today's code and pass with the fix; a scratch daemon with a real architect pane proves it after a real restart, with the parent commit as the 403 control. No daemon changes.

concerns: The rig's batch must be the architect's first capability-bearing action after the restart: a bash call first would recover the secret through the grant hook and defeat the test. The prompt in the plan says so; the transcript shows whether it was obeyed.
The model may serialise the two tool calls on the rig; the control run's 403 is what proves the batch raced. Repeat the restart+prompt once before calling the control inconclusive.
